# ScribeCat 0.24.6

- **Combined view** PDFs are now embedded as a real PDF window directly inside the Markdown document instead of appearing as a link.
- Existing local PDF links created by 0.24.5 are interpreted as the same embedded PDF media, so server-vault attachments no longer try to open as `/_attachments/*.pdf` web routes.
- The inline PDF window reuses the existing 0.24.3 reader: page controls, direct page jumping, page-text copy, and attached split view remain available.
- Swipe left/right on touch screens or use the keyboard arrow keys while the PDF viewer is focused to change pages.
- PDF.js now renders a selectable text layer over the page, allowing normal mouse/touch text selection.
- **Individual pages** insertion remains unchanged.

Compare: v0.24.5...v0.24.6
